name: Redsys (TPV Virtual)

webhook.algorithm: Not a JSON webhook — an async HTTP POST 'notificación online' to Ds_Merchant_MerchantURL with form fields `Ds_SignatureVersion`, `Ds_MerchantParameters` (base64url of minified JSON) and `Ds_Signature`. CURRENT official spec, verified verbatim on Redsys' developer site: Ds_SignatureVersion = `HMAC_SHA512_V2`; the per-order key is derived with `cifrado AES CBC` (AES-CBC, zero IV, merchant key truncated/padded to 16 chars, encrypting the order number); the signature is `HMAC SHA-512` over the base64 Ds_MerchantParameters string, base64url-encoded. evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: No API key. Credentials are: FUC/merchant code (9 digits), terminal number, and a base64 'clave secreta de comercio' issued by the bank. Test environment: sis-t.redsys.es:25443; live: sis.redsys.es. No key prefix regex exists — emit UNKNOWN

onboarding.note: Reached through your Spanish acquiring bank, not directly. The bank issues the FUC and terminal.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN and structurally unknowable from Redsys — pricing is set by the acquiring bank in the merchant's TPV contract, not by Redsys. providers.json should model this as fees: null with a note, not a guessed percentage.

notes: Practically every Spanish bank (Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank, Sabadell, Bankinter, Unicaja…) issues its e-commerce merchant account as a Redsys TPV Virtual, and Bizum for e-commerce is delivered through Redsys. A Spanish SMB that already has a bank merchant contract cannot ship without it, and no shipped provider covers it. It is also the single most-hallucinated integration in this cluster because the widely-copied open-source libraries are on the OLD signature version.

SDKs: NO official SDKs. Community only: node-redsys-api / redsys-pos (node), sermepa and various composer packages (php), redsys-client (python). Quality varies and several are pinned to HMAC_SHA256_V1 — the generator should emit the crypto inline rather than depend on an abandoned package.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps stripe only on the `bizum` method id. Otherwise no shipped coverage of Spanish bank acquiring.
Onboarding: partner_certification. Reached through your Spanish acquiring bank, not directly. The bank issues the FUC and terminal.
